resources.string: On a computer where you are already logged in to Instagram, open DevTools (F12) → Application → Cookies → https://www.instagram.com, and copy the value of the sessionid cookie. Paste it below.\n\nNo password is entered here. Using an existing session avoids the new-device login check.
sessionid value, or the whole cookie header
That does not look like a session key. It should start with your numeric user id followed by a colon.
Stored encrypted on this device only. Never uploaded, never logged.
